notes: Adds capability-negotiated individual Device PIN support for Backend 0.36.0-test.43. Update Backend to test.43 and Android to 1.0.19. Existing enrollment is preserved: the migration signs old Control sessions out once; the Backend owner sets each device PIN in Device Management and enables its Control access, then that device enters its PIN. The shared Backend PIN no longer unlocks remote Control; the separate PC Settings lock remains. Device PIN reset/clear revokes only that device's Control session and settings grant; Companion pairing and other devices remain intact. Native PIN handling stays private and memory-only. Cold app launch starts Companion; ordinary navigation/background keeps active Control unless explicitly locked, downgraded or revoked. Older Backends retain their existing shared-PIN behavior; old Android clients cannot promote on Backend43 without updating. Corrects the role-badge message shown in the reported screenshot: Control needs PC approval plus the configured PIN; QR is for enrollment, not role switching. All existing Singles Stats and updater fixes retained. 53 non-browser compatibility scripts and two real Backend43v2 integration tests passed, including actual bundled Android UI with native transport shim, cross-device PIN/grant negatives, reset/revocation and global-PC-PIN isolation. Independent review passed. Physical tablet acceptance remains pending. Original signing identity retained; iPad unchanged.
